proposal: Owner to relocate by 2027-02-28; otherwise we re-sequence the east area works.
question: The 11 kV cable along the east boundary is relocated only by 2027-06-30 (ALP-OWN-GEN-001). Our layout places the LDO tank farm and warehouse in the east. Can the relocation be completed by 2027-02-28?
response: Not possible: the relocation is carried out by the regional utility and 2027-06-30 is its committed date. The Contractor shall sequence the east-area works accordingly.
subject: Relocation of the buried 11 kV cable
